name: @agntux-build/agntux-slack-view-tool
description: View-tool library module for agntux-slack. Loaded server-side by the remote MCP registry; not invoked locally.

scripts.build: VITE_ENTRY=compose vite build && VITE_ENTRY=canvas vite build --emptyOutDir=false && tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/agntux-slack-view.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/agntux-slack-view.js --external:@agntux/plugin-runtime && node scripts/emit-manifest.mjs
